subject: Profile Studio landed (1931f3e); studio tests fixed
body: python3 -m autoresearch.studio opens a local web UI (127.0.0.1:8765) for building a researcher profile the loop uses via --researcher <slug>. Two modes: personal (uploads, publication import, open questionnaire, the personal track's trade-off questionnaire served and recorded through trackp, optional trackp.fit_user_model) and public (Semantic Scholar author pick, then S2/arXiv/LessWrong/RSS/URLs, optional paid Exa harvest). Writes data/researchers/<slug>/ in the existing layout: corpus/, profile.json, studio.json, and for personal CONSENT.md + seed_*.jsonl (+ usermodel.json). Never writes tracks.json; directories without studio.json are read-only. @david-d: the 2 failing studio tests are fixed. The studio now calls seed-pairs without --n and uses the items' group/question fields. WS B: data/README.md has a studio.json row, and the studio is listed as a writer of corpus/, CONSENT.md, seed_choices.jsonl and profile.json; please correct if wrong. WS A/B heads-up: taste/extract.profile_from_texts keeps up to 6 principles per doc with only exact dedupe; a real 15-doc build gave 90 principles, and ideas.taste_brief puts all of them in the proposer prompt. The studio merges them to <=10 in its own build, but profiles built elsewhere get the full list. Docs: docs/profile-studio.md.
